item.satisfying_weapons.desc.unlock_crit: {FF5555}To unlock, combine with an identical weapon of any level using Upgrader!
item.satisfying_weapons.firework_sword.s: Hitting an entity grants 1_stack of {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA}, up to 5_stacks. While in mid-air, press jump to consume 3_stacks and do a {F29C2A}Firework Jump{AAAAAA}; then, sneak to do a plunge attack. Switching out the weapon will clear all effects.
Plunge attack damage increases by 25% and is further increased by 15% for each entity in its current radius. Max total damage increase is_100%.
For each entity damaged by a plunge attack, recover 1_stack of {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA}. Max 2_stacks per plunge attack.
For each entity damaged by a plunge attack, recover 1_HP.
{ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA} can now go up to 10_stacks. Also, {ED1D6D}Festivity{AAAAAA} recovered from {EEEE66}Level_3{AAAAAA} is no longer limited to 2_stacks per plunge attack.
item.satisfying_weapons.glass_sword.skil: Dying with this sword in hand will shatter it and revive you, inflicting {8CFBFF}Glass Cut{AAAAAA} on all nearby entities for 90s. Entities with {8CFBFF}Glass Cut{AAAAAA} receive +2_additional damage when hurt. Use Anvil to repair Broken Glass Sword with Glass Panes.
When hitting an entity, there is a 30%_chance to inflict {8CFBFF}Glass Cut{AAAAAA} for 20s. This also applies to Broken Glass Sword.

After being revived, you will enter {5180A1}Broken Soul{AAAAAA} state for 12s, gaining speed and invincibility. The sword will shatter after {5180A1}Broken Soul{AAAAAA} ends, or if you remove it from your hand.
The chance to inflict {8CFBFF}Glass Cut{AAAAAA} on hit increases based on your missing HP, up to 80%. Broken Glass Sword has a 100%_chance to inflict {8CFBFF}Glass Cut{AAAAAA}.
{8CFBFF}Glass Cut{AAAAAA} can now stack up to 3_times. Entities with 2_/_3 stacks of {8CFBFF}Glass Cut{AAAAAA} will also have their regeneration reduced by 25%_/_50%, respectively.
item.satisfying_weapons.toy_bow.skill_de: Shoots {1E90FF}Toy Arrows{AAAAAA} that apply {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} for 10s to the target hit. While the target has an active {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA}, it will cause all non-friendly mobs to attack it.
Greatly increases accuracy and range of {1E90FF}Toy Arrows{AAAAAA}. Also, there is a 50%_chance to keep an arrow while shooting.

When {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} is applied, {F53C0F}Birthday Gift{AAAAAA} appears above the target’s head. After the {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} ends, or the target dies, {F53C0F}Birthday Gift{AAAAAA} will fall down and explode.
Entities with {F123DE}Birthday Party{AAAAAA} are slowed down and receive 15%_more damage.

Hitting a {F53C0F}Birthday Gift{AAAAAA} with a {1E90FF}Toy Arrow{AAAAAA} will cause it to explode and fire 5_identical {1E90FF}Toy Arrows{AAAAAA} in random directions, prioritizing other mobs as targets.
item.satisfying_weapons.sword_of_dying_s: Right-click to throw a {C1BFFF}Black Hole{AAAAAA}, which will continuously pull in surrounding entities before disappearing. Costs 3_durability.
Durability cost is reduced to_1. Throwing a {C1BFFF}Black Hole{AAAAAA} while sneaking will cause it to collect all items and experience into your inventory.
Entities affected by a {C1BFFF}Black Hole{AAAAAA} are inflicted with {6C3FE0}Entropy{AAAAAA} for 16s. Entities with {6C3FE0}Entropy{AAAAAA} receive 50%_more fall damage, and 20%_more overall damage.
Greatly decreases the cooldown for throwing {C1BFFF}Black Holes{AAAAAA}. Entities affected by a {C1BFFF}Black Hole{AAAAAA} now have a small chance to drop their equipment while being pulled in.

You can now ignore the cooldown for throwing {C1BFFF}Black Holes{AAAAAA} at the cost of 4_HP. Colliding two {C1BFFF}Black Holes{AAAAAA} creates a massive explosion, which can't damage the user nor items.
advancement.satisfying_weapons.root.desc: Kill monsters, craft wishes, collect weapons
